load_cfg_config_from_graph: load a CFG config from a JSON graph file using CFG_Config.from_graph
generate_valid_cfg_sequence: generate a valid terminal symbol sequence from the CFG using generate_onedata_pure
compute_ground_truth_next_token_distribu: compute the ground-truth next-token prediction distribution for a valid CFG sequence using solve_dp_prob_highprecision
compute_kl_divergence_between_distributi: compute KL divergence between the ground-truth distribution and a model's predicted next-token distribution
compute_minimum_editing_distance_via_slo: compute the minimum number of token changes needed to satisfy the CFG using solve_dp_noneq
